limitations: Host uses the existing linear contract, not arbitrary DAG or a new executor
Adapters are static and platform-reviewed; arbitrary Python kernels are not supported by relabeling
Original bounded text-resource capture, native approvals, action locks and required checks remain
Completion references are trusted internal declarations, not unrestricted public Guest file access
Controlled providers do not establish professional business correctness, token savings or global performance gains
AutoBiz validation covers PRD/knowledge/feedback/restart, not the complete seven-stage lifecycle
S6 stage snapshots, rollback, isolation debugger and intermediate rerun remain deferred
evidencePolicy: Raw logs, isolated runtime data and packages remain local. Published references use repository-relative evidence paths or redacted temporary run IDs; credentials and machine-specific absolute paths are excluded.
